summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised to 52.00 yen from 50.00 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, reflecting upward revision of net profit to 13.0 billion yen. Adjustment maintains target dividend payout ratio of approximately 30% under medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Mitsui Soko Holdings revised its full-year dividend forecast upward to 52.00 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027, from the previously announced 50.00 yen. The interim dividend remains at 27.00 yen per share. This adjustment follows an upward revision of consolidated earnings announced on the same date.

The company raised its net profit attributable to parent company shareholders to 13.0 billion yen from the prior forecast of 12.5 billion yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected cargo handling volumes in the logistics business, successful acquisition of new projects and establishment of new facilities, and benefits from cost reduction measures. The company also expects improved non-operating income from higher interest and dividend income and lower interest expenses from disciplined financing management.

According to the company's medium-term management plan 2022 (fiscal 2023–2027), the dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30% with flexible, performance-linked dividends. The revised dividend maintains alignment with this policy while reflecting the improved earnings outlook. The revision also allows the company to exceed its operating profit target of 23.0 billion yen under the same plan.
